segments.text: Many laboratory procedures, especially biological and biochemical ones, require the precise
segments.zh: 许多实验操作，尤其是生物学和生物化学的操作，都需要精确地

segments.text: transfer of small quantities of liquids.
segments.zh: 转移少量液体。

segments.text: Glass pipettes, which are commonly used in chemistry labs, are simply not accurate when
segments.zh: 化学实验室中常用的玻璃移液管，在处理小于 1 毫升的体积时

segments.text: working with volumes that are less than one milliliter.
segments.zh: 根本不准确。

segments.text: The best method of transferring small volumes of liquids involves the use of an automatic
segments.zh: 转移少量液体的最佳方法是使用移液器

segments.text: pipette.
segments.zh: （自动移液器）。

segments.text: An automatic pipette consists of a piston that displaces air to create a vacuum when
segments.zh: 移液器内有一个活塞，按下推杆时，活塞会排出空气以形成

segments.text: its plunger is pressed.
segments.zh: 负压。

segments.text: The tip of the automatic pipette is then placed into the sample vial and the plunger is slowly
segments.zh: 然后把移液器的吸头放入样品瓶中，缓慢

segments.text: released.
segments.zh: 松开推杆。

segments.text: This action draws liquid into the tip.
segments.zh: 这个动作会把液体吸入吸头。

segments.text: Finally, this liquid is expelled into the desired container by slowly depressing the
segments.zh: 最后，再次缓慢按下推杆，把液体排入所需的

segments.text: plunger a second time.
segments.zh: 容器中。

segments.text: As shown, a variety of automatic pipettes exist.
segments.zh: 如图所示，移液器有多种。

segments.text: This video will demonstrate automatic pipetting technique using the pipette men.
segments.zh: 本视频将用 Pipetman 移液器来演示移液技术。

segments.text: Using good technique will ensure accuracy, which is defined as the closeness of the dispensed
segments.zh: 良好的操作技术能确保准确度和精密度：准确度是指移出的

segments.text: volume to the set volume, and precision, which is defined as the reproducibility of
segments.zh: 体积与设定体积的接近程度，精密度是指

segments.text: individual measurements between your samples.
segments.zh: 各样品之间单次测量的可重现性。

segments.text: A pipette men consists of a plunger button, a tip ejector button, a volume adjustment knob,
segments.zh: Pipetman 由推杆按钮、退吸头按钮、体积调节旋钮、

segments.text: a volume indicator, and a plastic shaft.
segments.zh: 体积显示窗和塑料吸杆组成。

segments.text: Pipette men are available in six different sizes.
segments.zh: Pipetman 有六种不同的规格。

segments.text: Five of them are depicted here.
segments.zh: 这里展示了其中五种。

segments.text: The number on the plunger button indicates the maximum volume in microliters that each
segments.zh: 推杆按钮上的数字表示每支 Pipetman 所能转移的

segments.text: pipette men is capable of transferring.
segments.zh: 最大体积，单位为微升。

segments.text: For example, the P20 has a possible volume range of 0 to 20 microliters.
segments.zh: 例如，P20 的可用体积范围是 0 到 20 微升。

segments.text: However, transferring volumes at the low end of the range is not recommended because the
segments.zh: 不过，不建议在量程的低端转移液体，因为

segments.text: standard deviation is too high to ensure precision.
segments.zh: 标准偏差太大，无法保证精密度。

segments.text: Thus, the minimum amount of liquid that can be transferred in microliters is 0.1 for the
segments.zh: 因此，可转移液体的最小量（以微升计）分别是：P2 为 0.1，

segments.text: P2, 0.5 for the P10, 2 for the P20, 10 for the P100, 50 for the P200, and 100
for the P1000.
Now that we've covered what an automatic pipette is and how it works, we'll take a detailed
segments.zh: 我们已经介绍了移液器是什么以及它是如何工作的，下面我们来详细

segments.text: look into how the pipette men is used in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 看看在实验室里如何使用 Pipetman。

segments.text: Let's say, for example, your procedure requires you to transfer 153.5 microliters of sample.
segments.zh: 举个例子，假设你的操作步骤要求你转移 153.5 微升样品。

segments.text: The first step involves the selection of the pipette men with an appropriate volume range.
segments.zh: 第一步是选择体积范围合适的 Pipetman。

segments.text: In this example, a couple of choices exist.
segments.zh: 在这个例子中，有两种选择。

segments.text: The P200 has a recommended volume range of 50 to 200 microliters, while the P1000 has
segments.zh: P200 的推荐体积范围是 50 到 200 微升，而 P1000 的

segments.text: a recommended range of 100 to 1000 microliters.
segments.zh: 推荐范围是 100 到 1000 微升。

segments.text: Remember, the lower end of a volume range always has a higher standard deviation.
segments.zh: 记住，体积范围的低端总是有较大的标准偏差。

segments.text: Therefore, the P200 is the better choice.
segments.zh: 因此，P200 是更好的选择。

segments.text: The second step is the selection of the proper disposable plastic tip.
segments.zh: 第二步是选择合适的一次性塑料吸头。

segments.text: Three tip sizes exist.
segments.zh: 吸头有三种规格。

segments.text: The large blue tips, which fit the P1000, the medium yellow tips, which fit the P200, P100,
segments.zh: 大的蓝色吸头适用于 P1000，中号的黄色吸头适用于 P200、P100

segments.text: and P20, and the small white tips, which fit the P10 and P2.
segments.zh: 和 P20，小的白色吸头适用于 P10 和 P2。

segments.text: Because we're using the P200, we're going to need the yellow tips.
segments.zh: 因为我们用的是 P200，所以需要黄色吸头。

segments.text: Using the proper tip is essential for preventing leaks and promoting accurate delivery of liquids.
segments.zh: 使用合适的吸头，对于防止漏液和准确移取液体至关重要。

segments.text: After selecting the correct pipette men end tip, set the desired transfer volume.
segments.zh: 选好正确的 Pipetman 和吸头后，设定所需的转移体积。

segments.text: For the smaller pipette men, P2 to P200, the volume set on the indicator translates exactly
segments.zh: 对于较小的 Pipetman（P2 到 P200），显示窗上设定的体积就恰好

segments.text: into the volume that will be delivered.
segments.zh: 是将要移出的体积。

segments.text: This P200 is set to deliver a volume of 125.9 microliters.
segments.zh: 这支 P200 设定的移液体积是 125.9 微升。

segments.text: For the P1000, the volume set on the indicator must be multiplied by 10 to determine the
segments.zh: 对于 P1000，显示窗上设定的体积必须乘以 10，才是

segments.text: actual volume that will be transferred.
segments.zh: 实际转移的体积。

segments.text: This P1000 is set to deliver a volume of 1,259 microliters.
segments.zh: 这支 P1000 设定的移液体积是 1,259 微升。

segments.text: To correctly adjust the volume setting, turn the volume adjustment knob to one third of
segments.zh: 要正确调节体积设定，先把体积调节旋钮转到超过所需体积

segments.text: a revolution past the desired volume.
segments.zh: 三分之一圈的位置。

segments.text: Then slowly move the dial back down to the desired setting.
segments.zh: 然后再慢慢把刻度往回调到所需设定值。

segments.text: Always approach the desired volume by dialing downwards to prevent mechanical backlash and
segments.zh: 调到所需体积时，始终要从高往低调，以防止机械回程误差，

segments.text: to ensure precise volume transfer.
segments.zh: 并确保精确转移体积。

segments.text: When adjusting the volume of a pipette men, take care not to rotate the dial past the
segments.zh: 调节 Pipetman 的体积时，注意不要把旋钮转过

segments.text: maximum.
segments.zh: 最大值。

segments.text: You cannot transfer volumes above the range of the pipette men.
segments.zh: 你无法转移超出 Pipetman 量程的体积。

segments.text: Now it's time to transfer your sample.
segments.zh: 现在该转移你的样品了。

segments.text: You will need your appropriately sized pipette men set to the desired volume, the correctly
segments.zh: 你需要一支规格合适并已设定好所需体积的 Pipetman、规格正确的

segments.text: sized tips, a rack, the new container, a Kim wipe, and a waste container.
segments.zh: 吸头、一个吸头盒、新的容器、一张 Kimwipe 擦拭纸，以及一个废物容器。

segments.text: Attach a disposable tip to the pipette men by pressing its plastic shaft firmly into
segments.zh: 把 Pipetman 的塑料吸杆用力压入吸头，同时稍加旋转，

segments.text: the tip with a twisting motion.
segments.zh: 把一次性吸头装到 Pipetman 上。

segments.text: This action should ensure an airtight seal and prevent leaks from occurring.
segments.zh: 这个动作应能确保密封良好，防止漏液。

segments.text: Always use a new sterile tip for each sample and never let the tip touch anything except
segments.zh: 每个样品都要用新的无菌吸头，而且绝不要让吸头接触除

segments.text: sample.
segments.zh: 样品以外的任何东西。

segments.text: To draw sample into the plastic tip, depress the plunger until resistance is felt.
segments.zh: 要把样品吸入塑料吸头，先按下推杆，直到感到阻力。

segments.text: Hold the pipette men vertically and immerse it into the sample.
segments.zh: 垂直握住 Pipetman，把吸头浸入样品中。

segments.text: After the tip is immersed, slowly release the plunger to draw liquid into the tip.
segments.zh: 吸头浸入后，缓慢松开推杆，把液体吸入吸头。

segments.text: Wait a few seconds to ensure that the full volume of sample is drawn into the tip.
segments.zh: 等几秒钟，确保全部体积的样品都被吸入吸头。

segments.text: As a guide, wait one second for the P2 to P200 pipette men and two to three seconds
segments.zh: 作为参考，P2 到 P200 的 Pipetman 等一秒钟，P1000 等两到三

segments.text: for the P1000.
segments.zh: 秒钟。

segments.text: The larger the volume, or the more viscous the sample, the longer you should wait.
segments.zh: 体积越大，或者样品越黏稠，等待的时间就应越长。

segments.text: Remove the pipette men from the sample and carefully wipe excess liquids from the sides
segments.zh: 把 Pipetman 从样品中取出，小心地擦去吸头外壁上

segments.text: of the tip.
segments.zh: 多余的液体。

segments.text: To dispense the liquid in the pipette men, touch its tip to the side wall of a new
segments.zh: 要排出 Pipetman 中的液体，把吸头抵在新容器的

segments.text: container and slowly depress the plunger to the first stop.
segments.zh: 内壁上，缓慢按下推杆到第一档。

segments.text: Wait a few seconds to ensure complete sample flow, then press the plunger to the second
segments.zh: 等几秒钟，确保样品完全流出，然后把推杆按到第二

segments.text: stop to expel any remaining liquid.
segments.zh: 档，排出所有残留液体。

segments.text: With the plunger fully depressed, carefully remove the tip from the container by sliding
segments.zh: 在推杆完全按下的状态下，让吸头沿容器壁向上滑动，

segments.text: it up the container wall.
segments.zh: 小心地把吸头从容器中移出。

segments.text: The importance of sliding the tip along the wall increases as the volumes become smaller.
segments.zh: 体积越小，让吸头沿器壁滑动就越重要。

segments.text: Finally, allow the plunger to return to the up position.
segments.zh: 最后，让推杆回到上方位置。

segments.text: If you are done working with a particular sample, press the tip ejector button to release
segments.zh: 如果你已经处理完某个样品，就按下退吸头按钮，把

segments.text: the tip into the proper waste receptacle.
segments.zh: 吸头退到合适的废物容器中。

segments.text: Several other guidelines will help to ensure accuracy and precision when transferring liquids.
segments.zh: 另外还有几条准则，能帮助确保转移液体时的准确度和精密度。

segments.text: First, use a fresh tip for each sample to avoid contamination.
segments.zh: 第一，每个样品都用新吸头，以免污染。

segments.text: Second, pre-rinse each new tip.
segments.zh: 第二，对每个新吸头进行预润洗。

segments.text: Most liquids leave a film on the inside wall of a new tip, which affects the actual volume
segments.zh: 大多数液体会在新吸头的内壁上留下一层液膜，影响

segments.text: that can be transferred.
segments.zh: 实际能转移的体积。

segments.text: By pre-rinsing a tip, these volume variances are eliminated.
segments.zh: 通过预润洗吸头，可以消除这些体积偏差。

segments.text: To pre-rinse a tip, simply draw a solution into the tip and expel it into a waste container.
segments.zh: 预润洗吸头时，只需把溶液吸入吸头，再把它排入废物容器即可。

segments.text: Third, check the immersion depth.
segments.zh: 第三，检查浸入深度。

segments.text: If the immersion depth is too deep, liquid may get into the plastic shaft and damage
segments.zh: 如果浸入太深，液体可能会进入塑料吸杆，损坏

segments.text: the mechanics of the pipette men.
segments.zh: Pipetman 的机械部件。

segments.text: If the immersion depth is too shallow, air may be drawn into the tip, which greatly
segments.zh: 如果浸入太浅，可能会把空气吸入吸头，这会严重

segments.text: affects accuracy.
segments.zh: 影响准确度。

segments.text: As a general rule, immerse the white tips to a depth of 1-2 milliliters, the yellow
segments.zh: 一般来说，白色吸头浸入 1 到 2 毫升深，黄色

segments.text: tips to a depth of 2-3 milliliters, and the blue tips to a depth of 2-4 millimeters.
segments.zh: 吸头浸入 2 到 3 毫升深，蓝色吸头浸入 2 到 4 毫米深。

segments.text: If you do find an air bubble in the tip, dispense the sample into a waste container.
segments.zh: 如果你确实发现吸头里有气泡，就把样品排入废物容器。

segments.text: Check your immersion level and pipette more slowly.
segments.zh: 检查浸入深度，并更慢地移液。

segments.text: If you still see an air bubble, discard your current tip and use a new one.
segments.zh: 如果仍然看到气泡，就丢弃当前的吸头，换一个新的。

segments.text: Fourth, release the plunger button slowly.
segments.zh: 第四，缓慢松开推杆按钮。

segments.text: Do not let the plunger snap up.
segments.zh: 不要让推杆猛地弹起。

segments.text: This violent action may force liquid into the plastic shaft.
segments.zh: 这种剧烈的动作可能会把液体压进塑料吸杆。

segments.text: Fifth, when wiping excess liquid off the sides of the tip, avoid touching the tip opening
segments.zh: 第五，擦去吸头外壁多余的液体时，避免碰到吸头开口，

segments.text: because some of the sample may be lost.
segments.zh: 因为这可能会损失部分样品。

segments.text: Sixth, when liquid is in its tip, never allow the pipette men to tilt more than 20 degrees
segments.zh: 第六，吸头中有液体时，绝不要让 Pipetman 偏离竖直方向超过 20 度，

segments.text: from vertical and never lay the pipette men on its side.
segments.zh: 也绝不要把 Pipetman 平放。

segments.text: For optimum reproducibility, it is important to be consistent with your samples.
segments.zh: 为了获得最佳的可重现性，对各样品的操作保持一致很重要。

segments.text: Specifically, use a consistent speed and smoothness when pressing and releasing the push button.
segments.zh: 具体来说，按下和松开按钮时，速度和平稳程度要保持一致。

segments.text: Use consistent pressure at the first step, immerse the tip to a consistent depth, and
segments.zh: 在第一档处用力要一致，吸头浸入深度要一致，并且

segments.text: hold the pipette men at a consistent angle that is less than 20 degrees from vertical.
segments.zh: 握持 Pipetman 的角度要一致，偏离竖直方向不超过 20 度。

segments.text: If you are confident that you used good technique and are still seeing errors with accuracy or
segments.zh: 如果你确信自己操作得当，却仍然发现准确度或精密度有误差，

segments.text: precision, the following troubleshooting guidelines may fix your problem.
segments.zh: 下面这些排查准则也许能解决你的问题。

segments.text: To ensure that your pipette men is actually delivering the desired volume, you should
segments.zh: 为确保 Pipetman 确实移出了所需的体积，你应该

segments.text: periodically calibrate it.
segments.zh: 定期对它进行校准。

segments.text: To calibrate a pipette men, determine how many grams of your liquid equals one milliliter
segments.zh: 校准 Pipetman 时，根据液体的密度确定多少克液体

segments.text: from its density.
segments.zh: 相当于 1 毫升。

segments.text: For example, if water is the solvent, then one milliliter of water equals one gram of
segments.zh: 例如，如果溶剂是水，那么 1 毫升水就相当于 1 克

segments.text: water.
segments.zh: 水。

segments.text: Tear a small container on an analytical balance and set the pipette men at a volume near the
segments.zh: 在分析天平上给一个小容器去皮，把 Pipetman 设定在接近其量程

segments.text: top of its range.
segments.zh: 上限的某个体积。

segments.text: Transfer the set volume of liquid to the tared container on the balance and note the
segments.zh: 把设定体积的液体转移到天平上已去皮的容器中，记下

segments.text: mass of the liquid.
segments.zh: 液体的质量。

segments.text: Repeat this step five more times and determine the mean weight and standard deviation from
segments.zh: 把这一步再重复五次，根据你的测量结果求出平均重量和

segments.text: your measurements.
segments.zh: 标准偏差。

segments.text: Repeat the entire process with the pipette men set at a volume near the bottom of its
segments.zh: 再把 Pipetman 设定在接近其量程下限的某个体积，

segments.text: range.
segments.zh: 重复整个过程。

segments.text: If these values deviate from what you expect, adjust the pipette men accordingly when you
segments.zh: 如果这些值与你的预期有偏差，在转移液体时就要相应地

segments.text: transfer liquid.
segments.zh: 调整 Pipetman。

segments.text: Occasionally, the pipette men will begin to leak due to improperly fitted tips or worn
segments.zh: 有时，Pipetman 会因吸头安装不当或 O 形圈磨损

segments.text: o-rings.
segments.zh: 而开始漏液。

segments.text: To check for leaks, put a fresh tip on the pipette men, pre-rinse the tip, and draw
segments.zh: 要检查是否漏液，给 Pipetman 装上新吸头，预润洗吸头，然后吸

segments.text: up liquid.
segments.zh: 取液体。

segments.text: Keep the pipette men vertical and wait about 20 seconds.
segments.zh: 保持 Pipetman 竖直，等待约 20 秒。

segments.text: If you see a droplet, then the pipette men is leaking.
segments.zh: 如果你看到液滴，说明 Pipetman 在漏液。

segments.text: Two final things that decrease the accuracy and precision of the pipette men involve
segments.zh: 最后还有两件事会降低 Pipetman 的准确度和精密度：

segments.text: pipetting samples below 4 or above 70 degrees Celsius and using the pipette men with
segments.zh: 移取低于 4 摄氏度或高于 70 摄氏度的样品，以及用 Pipetman

segments.text: acids and corrosives.
segments.zh: 移取酸和腐蚀性液体。

segments.text: If you absolutely must pipette an acid or corrosive, then you should disassemble the
segments.zh: 如果你确实必须移取酸或腐蚀性液体，就应当立即拆开

segments.text: pipette men immediately to inspect and clean the piston, shaft, seal assemblies, and
segments.zh: Pipetman，检查并清洗活塞、吸杆、密封组件和

segments.text: o-rings.
segments.zh: O 形圈。

segments.text: To summarize, using proper technique with an automatic pipette is essential for ensuring
segments.zh: 总之，正确使用移液器的操作技术，对于确保

segments.text: accuracy and precision.
segments.zh: 准确度和精密度至关重要。

segments.text: A few key points to remember include the following.
segments.zh: 需要记住的几个要点如下。

segments.text: Be consistent with plunger timing and pressure, as well as immersion time and depth.
segments.zh: 推杆操作的时间和力度、浸入的时间和深度都要保持一致。

segments.text: Use a fresh pre-rinse tip for each new sample.
segments.zh: 每个新样品都使用预润洗过的新吸头。

segments.text: Check for air bubbles and leaks during each transfer and calibrate the automatic pipette
segments.zh: 每次转移时都要检查是否有气泡和漏液，并定期校准

segments.text: periodically.
segments.zh: 移液器。

segments.text: In addition, take care not to drop the expense of an easily damaged pipette men.
segments.zh: 此外，注意不要摔落昂贵且易损的 Pipetman。

segments.text: Do not allow the tip to touch anything except sample.
segments.zh: 不要让吸头接触除样品以外的任何东西。

segments.text: Do not introduce liquid into the plastic shaft by letting the plunger snap up or
segments.zh: 不要让推杆猛地弹起或把 Pipetman 平放，

segments.text: by laying the pipette men on its side.
segments.zh: 以免液体进入塑料吸杆。

segments.text: Finally, avoid using the pipette men under extreme temperature conditions or with acids
